answer: Trust the job, not the address that sent it. Each task carries a hardware attestation signed by a secure enclave, and payment is released only when the quoted code hash matches the registered one. Gather attestations by subnet and tax any group dominated by one of them. Ten accounts behind a single gale of rack traffic show one enclave family, so their votes count once. Copper stamped once cannot pass as ten bars, and shale cracks the same way under load.
